formula_validation.independent_exact_witness: Archived physical IDs and receiver counts verify every rank/card/DP volume range and both DP row-sharing bounds. No transfer of the M3 route distribution to prefill.

scope: Historical v168 eager first-token prefill. Input counts conserve six assignments per valid row; native ranks and layers use the existing pinned task bindings. Costs are conditional on unchanged routing and placement.

method.cuts: Over unrestricted assignment matrices with these integer marginals, minimum crossing = total minus sum(min(S_g,R_g)); maximum = total minus sum(max(0,S_g+R_g-total)). For the maximum, off-diagonal bipartite groups permit any split if no group has S_g+R_g>total (capacitated Hall); at most one group has an unavoidable diagonal excess. Distinct top-k IDs or real router choices may narrow these outer bounds. Net DP0 outward minus inward is S_0-R_0 exactly.
method.bytes: One logical INT8[5120] and FP32 scale per expert assignment in the pinned peer-input contract. GB decimal, two DP-cut directions counted once. Ranges exclude return, protocol, stride, deduplication and any physical bus or time inference.
method.sharing: For n executed assignments sent across one direction of the DP cut from t valid local source rows, the number of distinct source-row deliveries lies in [ceil(n/6), min(n,t)]. The number of extra logical input arrivals lies in [max(0,n-t), n-ceil(n/6)]. Both bounds are monotone in n, so the endpoint direction counts give conservative bounds. This credits only an ideal one-arrival-per-token-per-opposite-DP input path. It requires local fanout, preserving scales, slot order, weights and distinct expert results. The DP partition is logical and does not establish a cheaper physical link inside a DP.
method.volume_sensitivity: Difference of route endpoints times 5124. Dividing by 1% of that historical TTFT expresses uncertainty in GB/s units for a fully serialized, constant aggregate latency-per-byte model. This is a sampling priority calculation. It is not a measured rate or a service improvement.
method.clocks: Same constant rank offsets and causal count-exchange constraints as PREFILL-OA-JOINT-ARRIVAL. For sets L,R the sharp upper of max(L+o)-max(R+o) is max_i min_j(L_i-R_j+bound[i][j]). Set o_j=-bound[i][j] to realize the optimizing i. Lower follows by swapping L/R. Min/max are per layer; their sum can be conservative for a single offset vector.
method.one_rank_exit: At most one rank per layer finishes arbitrarily earlier, with all other finishes fixed. Even an oracle selecting the rank cannot move the latest recorded F21 finish by more than its separation from the runner-up. Sums by request illustrate the barrier-only model. The model does not cover earlier local next-layer progress or cross-rank changes in peer readiness.

limits: Exact cross-DP assignments, per-token reuse, physical link bytes and transport-only time are distinct observables. Historical large-M ID banks were not enabled by the pinned v168 capture guard. A two-bin executed-assignment counter per source suffices for exact between-DP totals, but cannot price per-token destination reuse.

No all-rank barrier at F21 exit is assumed for the model. Next-layer HcPre is observed per rank for 39 transitions per carrier; intervening work includes observer operations. Whole-kernel duration does not separate waits, compute, copy and return. No global model ceiling or service-speed claim.
